home.faqSubtitle: Uploads, the wall, music, wishes, and privacy.

noApp.a: No. Guests open your album link or scan the QR code in the browser. They upload without creating an account.

download.q: Can I download all photos and videos?
download.a: Yes. Save individual files from the album, or download the full set when you want everything offline.

multiDay.a: Your album stays open across the whole celebration. Guests can keep contributing before, during, and after.

wall.q: How does the photo wall work?
wall.a: The wall is a browser slideshow that updates as approved uploads arrive. Open it on any screen and cast or connect to a TV or projector.

music.a: Guests search tracks from the album Music tab and send a request with an optional note. Hosts and DJs manage the queue in the DJ booth — Eventos stores title, artist, and artwork so the DJ can play from their own decks. We don’t stream full copyrighted tracks in the app.

wishes.a: Guests can record a short sealed message (up to 30 seconds) during the event. Hosts unlock and listen after the celebration ends — a quieter keepsake beside the photos.

privacy.a: Albums are private by default. Only people with your share link can view or contribute. Your media stays yours.

moderation.q: What if someone uploads something inappropriate?
moderation.a: You can remove uploads from your dashboard anytime. For larger events, turn on moderation so new media needs approval before it reaches the wall.

photographer.q: We already have a photographer — is this still useful?
photographer.a: Yes. Pros can’t stand in every corner. Guest shots add candids your photographer may miss, and they can appear on the wall too.
